blocks.text: Jab liquid garam kiya jata hai to us ka vapour pressure barhta rehta hai, aur ek marhala aata hai jab vapour pressure hawai ya bairooni dabao ke barabar ho jata hai; is darja hararat par liquid ubalna shuru karta hai. Liquid ke andar bane bukharat ke bulbulon ka androoni dabao ab satah par hawai dabao se zyada hai, to woh liquid se oopar aa kar satah par phat-te hain, aur boiling point par bulbulon ka musalsal silsila nikalta hai. Liquid garam karne se us ke molecules ki kinetic energy aur yun darja hararat barhta hai; boiling point par kinetic energy apni intiha par hoti hai, aur mazeed garmi darja hararat nahi barhati balke intermolecular forces torne aur liquid ko bukharat banane mein kharch hoti hai. Figure 5.9 pani, ethyl alcohol, ethylene glycol aur diethyl ether ke vapour pressures darja hararat ke muqable dikhata hai: har liquid apne boiling point par tab pohnchta hai jab us ka vapour pressure samandar ki satah par 760 torr ke barabar ho, diethyl ether 34.6, ethanol 78.3 aur pani 100 degrees C par.

blocks.prompt: Ubalte pani ka darja hararat chahe kitna hi zor se garam karein 100 degrees C par kyun rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Boiling point par molecules pehle hi woh zyada se zyada kinetic energy rakhte hain jo liquid us dabao par rakh sakta hai. Mazeed hararat liquid ko bukharat banane ke liye intermolecular forces torne par kharch hoti hai, molecules ko tez karne par nahi, to darja hararat tab tak mustaqil rehta hai jab tak sara liquid ubal na jaye.

items: Liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bairooni dabao ke barabar ho; andar bulbule ban kar nikalte hain; boiling point par izafi hararat darja hararat barhane ke bajaye intermolecular forces torti hai.
760 torr par diethyl ether 34.6, ethanol 78.3 aur pani 100 degrees C par ubalta hai.
